user.title: Connect to Render
user.description:
Please enter a Render API key. An API key can be created on the API Keys page of the Render dashboard: {api_keys_url}

Render API keys cannot be restricted to read-only access. This integration performs read operations (GET requests) only and never modifies anything on Render.

data_description.api_key: The key is stored only in Home Assistant and is never written to the log.

services.title: Select the services
services.description: Select the services in {workspace} to monitor. If all services remain selected, services added later will also be monitored.

reauth_confirm.title: New Render API key
reauth_confirm.description: Render rejected the saved API key for {workspace}. Please enter a new API key from {api_keys_url}
